name: Montenegro
description: Montenegro from Duklja and the prince-bishops to a kingdom, Yugoslavia, independence in 2006 and the Bay of Kotor.

checkpoints.name: Duklja and Zeta
checkpoints.note: Duklja and then Zeta ruled the coast and mountains.

checkpoints.name: The prince-bishops
checkpoints.note: Prince-bishops ruled from Cetinje and kept the mountains free of the Ottomans. Montenegro was recognised in 1878 and became a kingdom in 1910.

checkpoints.name: Yugoslavia
checkpoints.note: Montenegro joined Yugoslavia in 1918 and stayed with Serbia after the break-up.

checkpoints.name: Independent Montenegro
checkpoints.note: Montenegro voted for independence in 2006 and joined NATO in 2017.
